title: Modeling Cell Dynamics and Interactions with Unbalanced Mean Field Schrödinger Bridge
tldr_zh: UMFSB 框架把细胞交互项加入 unbalanced SB，CytoBridge 四网络从快照学速度/增长/密度/交互势，合成与 scRNA-seq 上 W1、TMV 优于 DeepRUOT 等基线
tldr_en: UMFSB adds cell-cell interaction to unbalanced SB; CytoBridge learns velocity, growth, density, interaction potential from snapshots, beating DeepRUOT on W1/TMV
